summary: Ludlow Ventures is an early-stage venture firm established in 2010 whose homepage says its approach has not changed since: meet exceptional founders early, build real relationships and back them. Founder testimonials on the site describe the firm as a first investor and seed investor in companies such as Honey, StockX and Density. The website publishes a portfolio list and team names, but no stage definition, sector focus, geography, check size, application route or street address.

investmentEvidence.fact: Co-founder Ryan Hudson is quoted on the homepage saying Ludlow was among the first investors in the seed round. The date is not stated.
Co-founder Greg Schwartz is quoted on the homepage describing Ludlow as a partner since the beginning. Round and date are not stated.

sources.title: Homepage: approach, founder testimonials and portfolio links
